title: Use ripgrep glob filters instead of Windows wildcard path arguments
failure_signature: A ripgrep command received a wildcard in the path position and returned an invalid filename or directory error after partial output from an earlier command.
trigger_preconditions: Wildcard embedded in a path argument
Multiple discovery operations in one command envelope
candidate_workaround: Search the concrete scripts directory and restrict filenames with ripgrep -g, keeping the receipt read and code search as separate bounded operations.
recurrence_guard: Use -g for filename wildcards on Windows and require the whole discovery command to exit successfully before treating it as complete evidence.
rollback: Discard the incomplete aggregate discovery result; no repository state changed because the failed operation was read-only.
protected_gates: No task creation or sibling contact
scope_boundary: This method addresses Windows search invocation only and proves no repository, scientific, authority, or reproduction claim.
